notes: Strip a: x 0-2260 plus overlap to ~2560. Ivanhoe printed 'AVENUE' near the top and 'IVANHOE' lower down; its west street line is the plate's west edge for most of its length (centre drifts from x~671 at the top to ~708 near Montgomery). Montgomery Road (printed 'MONTGOMERY' bottom-left and 'RO...' to the NE, 60 ft) runs NNE straight through the strip; centre taken between the block lines (interior lines are streetcar tracks, pipes and sewers; addresses are printed inside the street). No suffix printed in this strip for Weyer, Wanda, Williams, Cameron, Slane, Cleneay (recorded bare). The diagonal ESE street from Wanda's bend to Montgomery Road carries only 'AVE.'; recorded as Wanda (continuous street, no break). The large spaced letters 'E D W. M I L L S' crossing it are subdivision lettering, not its name. Courtland and Lexington each jog at a N-S street (Allison, Regent): both offsets recorded as separate T junctions. Not streets: the C. L. & N. railroad (diagonal through Montgomery at y~2240 and across Delaware/Williams/Ivanhoe), the railroad and CITY LIMITS band along the south edge (y~6650-6750), the coloured subdivision/boundary bands (e.g. N-S blue band at x~2110-2130 north of Hopkins, yellow band x~2150-2170 south of Williams).
